calls.statement:
SELECT 
  m.home_store_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN m.home_store_id = 900 THEN 'Online sign-ups'
    ELSE s.store_name 
  END AS store_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS new_members
FROM dim_member m
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = TRUE
WHERE m.join_date >= '2025-04-28' 
  AND m.join_date <= '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY m.home_store_id, store_name
ORDER BY m.home_store_id
